title: Particles collected per unit time
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be N/2, derived from the fraction of particles hitting plate CD.

title: Electric field kinematics
description: Important: Correctly applies kinematics to find the vertical displacement and exit angle (45°) from the parallel plates.

title: Magnetic field radius
description: Important: Correctly uses the Lorentz force law to show the radius of circular motion in the magnetic field equals R.

title: Maximum magnetic field time
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be expressed as (49√2 π R)/(180 v₀) or equivalent, based on the correct central angle (98°).

title: Screen hit length
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be expressed as (1 - √2/2)R/3 or equivalent, derived from geometric analysis on the exit from the magnetic field.

title: Geometry of exit
description: Important: Correctly analyzes the geometry at point D and the exit point K to find relevant angles (e.g., 45°, 37°) for time and screen length calculations.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout the solution and in final expressions.

title: Sign or force direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns direction of electric or magnetic force, leading to wrong trajectory or angle.

title: Angle misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies the central angle for the magnetic motion (e.g., using 37° or 45° directly instead of 98°).
